verses.text: For the music director. For Jeduthun. A psalm of David. I find rest in God alone. My rescue comes from him.
He alone is my rock and my saviour. He is my fortress, so I will never be badly shaken.
How long will all of you attack one man? Will all of you push him down, like a leaning wall or a broken fence?
They only plan to push him down from his high position. They love telling lies. They bless with their mouths, but in their hearts they curse. Selah.
Find rest, my soul, quietly in God alone. My hope comes from him.
He alone is my rock and my saviour. He is my fortress, so I will not be shaken.
My rescue and my honour depend on God. He is my strong rock and my safe place.
Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your hearts to him. God is our safe place. Selah.
Ordinary people are only a breath, and important people are just a lie. If you put them on a scale, together they weigh less than a breath.
Do not trust in taking things by force. Do not hope in stolen goods. Even if your riches grow, do not set your heart on them.
God has spoken one thing, and I have heard it twice: power belongs to God.
Faithful love also belongs to you, Lord. You pay back each person for what they have done.
